page_title: NEW 3-0 WOL | Newcastle v Wolves 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Darren England has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
90+7' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

90+5' This was a piece of cake for Martin Dubravka. Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
90+3' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
90+2' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
86' That's the end of the game for Andre, who is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
86' Vitor Pereira has decided to substitute Joao Gomes and he is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
85' Substitution. Valentino Livramento leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
85' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) receives a yellow card.

83' This was a nice effort by both teams. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) connected with a cross from the side inside the box and slammed it straight towards the top of the net. Martin Dubravka leapt like a salmon and tipped the ball onto the bar.
83' Here is a change. Joelinton is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
82' Celebrations are cut short for Wolves as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
81' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
79' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) scores from the resulting corner. The ball slips through the box to Santiago Bueno (Wolves) and he smashes it inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
79' The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' A substitution has been made. Alexander Isak goes off and William Osula (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
78' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) replaces Jacob Murphy.
78' Substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) replaces Anthony Gordon.
77' Darren England sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
75' Wait! Referee Darren England has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

74' 3 - 0 Goal Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd)! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) was put through by Alexander Isak and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
73' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
71' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Martin Dubravka has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
70' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:0.
69' Vitor Pereira decides to make a substitution. Goncalo Guedes will be replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rodrigo Gomes will be replaced by Nelson Semedo (Wolves).
68' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
68' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) prepares to take a corner kick.
67' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
65' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
64' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
62' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Martin Dubravka easily deals with the threat.
59' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

57' 2 - 0 Goal! Bruno Guimaraes shows great vision to find Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
53' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
52' Newcastle work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
50' Jose Sa (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
49' Jose Sa (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
47' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Santiago Bueno (Wolves). Darren England saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
46' Vitor Pereira has made a change at the break. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) has come on in place of Hee-Chan Hwang.
46' The whistle blows and Darren England starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) got to the ball inside the six-yard box all of a sudden and slammed it towards the goal, but unfortunately hits one of his teammates instead of scoring.
45+2' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
45+1' Dangerous play by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd). Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
43' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
38' Newcastle are seeing far more of the ball now.

34' 1 - 0 GOAL 1:0! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
34' The total number of attempts is 6:1.
31' Close! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
30' Referee Darren England sees the trip by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
30' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
29' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
29' A spell of possession for Newcastle in an attempt to control the game.
26' Matt Doherty (Wolves) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
25' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) inside the box.
24' What an amazing save by Jose Sa! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails.
23' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
22' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
21' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves).
18' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is flagged for offside.
16' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves).
14' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
13' The ball falls kindly for Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the left post.
13' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
9' Newcastle players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
6' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
4' Andre (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Darren England signals.
2' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
1' The match has just started.
Wolves will kick the game off.
Darren England will referee today's match.
